decisions.reason: After two selling seasons this close-to-core carpet has had time to prove itself, but with no visible failure and with one similar carpet already pruned, management would likely retain it while monitoring whether it clears aspiration levels.
The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet remains a niche offer with some demand risk, yet its fit with the firm's craftsmanship and premium design identity makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Because it is another low-pile decorative carpet in a portfolio where a similar item was already withdrawn, it faces the strongest aspiration-based pruning risk, though it is still slightly more likely to be kept than dropped.
The corner bench builds directly on the firm's established furniture and project business, so it is likely to meet internal aspirations well enough to stay on the market.
As a multi-model swivel shell chair line close to the core offer, it provides broad application and learning value, making withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
